title: the by-id read cache (`kind: cache`): hits, eviction on every write path, and scope isolation across tenants, roles, masks and policy rungs

apiCaller.//: The registry (`Org`) serves its two reads and no writes; its self-scope hides every row from the harness principal.  `api.relabel.run(...)` drives a command workflow — a write path the cache must evict on (a not-lifted workflow route).
